description: Create a new Storage Box in the given location and type. Billing applies for the provisioned resource.

access_settings.description: Initial access settings for the Storage Box

reachable_externally.description: Whether the Storage Box is reachable from outside the Hetzner network

zfs_enabled.description: Whether the ZFS snapshot directory is exposed

location.description: ID or name of the location, e.g. "fsn1"

ssh_keys.description: SSH public keys in OpenSSH format to inject into the Storage Box

storage_box_type.description: ID or name of the Storage Box type, e.g. "bx20"
